main_text.p: Inquisitor mortuus anno millesimo trecentesimo nonagesimo tertio, postquam officio illo per 37. annos functus esset, his verbis exprimit: Nemo potest liberare eos, qui ab inquisitione sunt apprehensi. Hæc igitur Bellarm. & aliorum Pontificiorum sententia est. Nos è contrario affirmativam tuemur, & contra Bellarm. hanc propositionē formamus: Quemadmodum Magistratus officium est operam dare, ut disciplina Ecclesiastica à Christo instituta conservetur: ita etiam ipsius est curare, ut illa legitimè à Pastoribus in consistoriis & aliis judiciis Ecclesiasticis exerceatur; efficere ne abusus circa eam committantur; impedire ne cuipiam injuria fiat in ejus administratione; & si quidem injuria alicui fiat aut facta sit à Pastoribus per exercitium seu potius abusum disciplinae Ecclesiasticae, sive in Consistorio sive in Synodo; licet ei apud Magistratum conqueri, ut Custodem ac vindicem externi ordinis in Ecclesiâ à Christo instituti: & tunc tenetur

page.notes: The running head line carries a section mark with the number "VII." at the top right ("Q VII."), which I left out of the running head since it is a section number. The word "sententia" is broken at the line end after "sen." without a visible hyphen; I wrote it whole. The Google digitiser watermark at the lower right is omitted. The word "tenetur" at the lower right is a catchword, not text of the paragraph, but it also repeats the last word of the paragraph, so it is printed as the catchword. The opening paragraph has no indent and is treated as continuing from the previous page.
